jobs.title: General Consideration - Corporate Development
jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

General Application Information

This is not for a specific role . By applying here, you're joining our talent pool for future opportunities .

While submitting this general application adds your profile to our Business Development talent pool for future consideration, we highly encourage you to check our careers page regularly and apply directly to any open positions that align with your qualifications and interests. This ensures you're actively considered for roles that match your skills, as we typically prioritize applications to specific job postings first when filling open positions.

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

Our team blends skill sets from sales, marketing, product development, negotiation, and project management. We align strategically across the company, and we work with partners in a variety of industries, keeping it fast-paced and exciting every day!

Even if there isn’t an immediate opening in Business Development that matches your background, we’d love to keep your info on hand for future opportunities. Submit a general application here, and in your cover letter, let us know why you’re passionate about onX and what unique skills you bring!

Just a reminder : This general application won’t replace applying for specific roles, so be sure to check back often and apply for any openings that fit your skills and experience.

Want to stay connected? Follow us on  LinkedIn !

WHERE TEAM MEMBERS ARE LOCATED

L ocation requirements will vary by role and will be detailed in the specific job postings.

With our headquarters in  Missoula and Bozeman, MT, and Basecamp locations throughout the US, we are inspired by the landscapes that surround us. We bring our enthusiasm for technology and the outdoors to work every day, with the goal of inspiring others to find their way in the wild. Basecamps are emerging locations where fully remote onXers cluster for work and adventure. Currently, our Bascamps are located within a 90-mile radius of the following cities:

- Austin, TX

- Denver, CO

- Minneapolis, MN

- Portland, OR

- Salt Lake City, UT

- Seattle, WA

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

C ompensation details will be job-specific and outlined in individual postings .

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. The pay range for any position will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com  or directly via our LinkedIn page.

onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. For more information, see our Privacy Policy .

As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt-out if preferred.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

In the role of Senior Financial Analyst – Strategic Finance & Special Projects, you will serve as a high-impact analytical resource for onX's most senior leaders. Rather than supporting a specific product vertical, you will work directly at the direction of the CEO, CFO, and Senior Director of FP&A on the company's most complex, ambiguous, and consequential financial and strategic questions. You will operate at the intersection of finance and data — with the technical depth to pull and interrogate data independently and the business acumen to translate findings into clear narratives that shape executive decision-making.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

- Lead end-to-end analysis on special and ad hoc projects assigned by the CEO, CFO, and Senior Director of FP&A — with a primary focus on operational and business performance across the company, identifying trends and anomalies, constructing a narrative, and delivering clear recommendations.

- Perform financial modeling and analysis to evaluate organic and inorganic growth opportunities, new business lines, pricing strategies, operational investments, etc.

- Manage ad-hoc projects that include areas of analysis such as market sizing, scenario modeling, long-term strategic opportunity assessment, etc., as directed.

- Develop and stress-test business cases for major strategic initiatives, providing leadership with a grounded view of expected returns and key assumptions.

- Independently source, extract, and manipulate data from multiple internal and external sources — operating as a self-sufficient analytical resource (including Tableau, Pitchbook, Amplitude, etc.)

- Partner closely with the Business Intelligence team to build scalable data pipelines, improve data accessibility, and inform the development of analytical infrastructure that supports the broader finance function.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related analytical field.

- Six (6) or more years of experience in finance, strategy, investment banking, management consulting, or a related analytical function.

- Advanced SQL proficiency — you are comfortable writing complex queries, joining multiple data sources, and extracting insights independently from large datasets.

- Strong financial modeling capabilities, including scenario analysis, sensitivity modeling, DCF, and ROI frameworks.

- Experience working directly with or embedded near a Business Intelligence or data engineering function.

- Experience evaluating M&A opportunities and/or conducting deep strategic business and market analysis, including market sizing, competitive analysis, and investment or growth opportunity assessment.

- Demonstrated ability to operate in high-ambiguity environments with minimal direction, structuring problems from scratch and driving to actionable conclusions.

- Exceptional written communication skills — onX is a document-driven company and you will regularly produce narrative-format analyses and recommendations for senior leadership.

- Proven comfort presenting complex analyses to C-suite and senior executives, including handling pushback and adapting on the fly.

- A desire to learn and actively leverage AI tools to improve analytical speed and quality.

- Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously.

- Experience in a B2C SaaS or subscription business is strongly preferred.

- Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

- A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

- MBA or advanced degree in a relevant field

- M&A, corporate development, or investment banking experience

- Strong preference will be given to those located in Salt Lake, Missoula, or Bozeman,areas where other finance employees are concentrated.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

Preference will be given to applicants based in the greater Salt Lake City area for this role, as this is where most of onX's Finance team is located. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members. At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Dakota, West Virginia, or Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $137,000 to $170,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

- Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth

- Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan

- Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents

- 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%

- Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks

- Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle

- Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com .

- Identify and test new approaches to advocacy storytelling, channel activation, and customer engagement, using insights and results to strengthen future work.

- Extend and adapt Access & Stewardship stories across onX brand and vertical marketing efforts, balancing program needs with broader brand priorities.

Storytelling & Brand Stewardship

- Develop credible, engaging storytelling that helps customers understand and act on issues related to public land access and responsible recreation.

- Steward the Access & Stewardship brand identity, messaging, and design guidelines, ensuring consistent expression within the broader onX brand while identifying opportunities to evolve the work.

- Write, edit, and guide content across web, in-app, campaign, editorial, partner, and other customer-facing channels.

- Partner with Brand Creative to develop high-quality assets and storytelling that are accurate, distinctive, and on-brand.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Build strong partnerships across Access & Stewardship, Brand, PR, Vertical Marketing, Product, Geospatial, and external partners to bring advocacy marketing initiatives to market.

- Drive cross-functional coordination and proactively navigate dependencies, risks, and trade-offs to keep work moving and deliver strong outcomes.

- Partner with Access & Stewardship and Brand leadership to understand priorities, timing, and context and translate them effectively into marketing initiatives.

- Bring clarity and recommendations to cross-functional partners, resolving routine alignment and execution issues while escalating broader strategic or program-level decisions when needed.

Measurement & Reporting

- Recommend and track success measures for advocacy marketing initiatives, aligned with broader Brand measurement priorities.

- Monitor campaign performance and use insights, customer response, and partner feedback to improve future work.

- Communicate performance, insights, and recommendations to partners and Brand leadership, connecting marketing outcomes to Access & Stewardship program goals and broader business objectives.

- Experience translating complex or nuanced subject matter into clear, credible, and engaging marketing, with strong judgment around accuracy, brand integrity, and stakeholder sensitivity.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience building alignment and influencing partners across different functions and areas of expertise.

- Strong integrated marketing experience, including comfort developing marketing for social channels.

- Experience using campaign performance, audience insights, and feedback to evaluate effectiveness and inform future marketing decisions.

- Experience using AI tools in day-to-day work to improve productivity, creativity, and quality, with curiosity about how emerging capabilities can strengthen marketing work and sound judgment over outputs.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager who will contribute to meaningful, real-world outcomes that have a lasting impact for customers and the business. In this role, you'll focus on driving subscription growth for onX Hunt - Day 7 (D7) and Day 30 (D30) conversion, free-to-paid movement, and reactivation of lapsed users - as part of the Growth & Lifecycle Marketing team, supporting the team's goal of converting, retaining, and reactivating subscribers across onX's verticals. You'll take ownership of your work, collaborate closely with partners across the organization, and help move initiatives forward in an environment where priorities evolve, learning is celebrated, and you're encouraged to keep stretching your skills.  This role will report to Manager of Growth and Lifecycle Marketing.

The best lifecycle marketers at onX don't wait for insights to be handed to them: they live in the data, form sharp hypotheses about user behavior, test them quickly and cleanly, document what they learn, and compound those learnings into the next experiment. If you get energy from turning user behavior into revenue - and from building AI-powered systems that let one marketer operate like five - this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

- Own the lifecycle conversion funnel for onX Hunt - D7 and D30 conversion, free-to-paid upgrade, and lapsed-user reactivation - and be accountable for moving those numbers.

- Self-serve insights in Amplitude, synthesize learnings into clear, testable hypotheses, and apply propensity models and behavioral segmentation to reach the right user, at the right time, with the right message.

- Run lifecycle as a compounding experimentation program: every test has a hypothesis, a clean measurement design (A/B, holdout, or validation test), and a documented outcome that feeds the next iteration - maintained at a high-velocity cadence across email, push, and in-app messaging in Braze.

- Scale personalized messaging that translates features into value and outcomes - getting users to their aha moment faster so they convert with confidence - and partner with product, engineering, and BI to define the events and attributes that unlock personalization in Braze.

- Self-serve your own experiment analysis and results readouts, communicating outcomes - including honest caveats and null results - to stakeholders and leadership.

- Work cross-functionally with finance, brand and growth marketing, and the Hunt vertical creative team to align lifecycle programs with revenue goals, campaign windows, and creative standards; build creative briefs and lightweight assets in Figma.

- Use AI (Claude and similar tools) to build repeatable skills, agents, and workflows that automate campaign production and analysis - scaling personalization well beyond what manual effort allows.

- Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co-pilot in daily workflows by integrating experimentation into real work, and continuously refining its use with sound judgment and validation.

- Mentor junior lifecycle marketers on experimentation rigor and AI-enabled workflows, and champion shared standards for how the team runs and documents tests.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Eight (8) years of lifecycle, CRM, retention, or growth marketing experience is required, with a background in consumer subscription or mobile app businesses.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or equivalent experience.

- A strong experimentation track record: you've designed, run, analyzed, and documented A/B tests that produced measurable conversion or retention gains - and you can talk through your wins, your nulls, and what you learned from each.

- A strong understanding of user behavior, with a demonstrated ability to generate insights in Amplitude (or similar product analytics tools) and synthesize them into hypotheses.

- Working knowledge of propensity models and predictive targeting.

- Proficiency with Braze (or a comparable CRM platform), Amplitude, Figma, and Claude or similar AI tools - and demonstrated proficiency using AI to develop new skills and workflows that scale your impact.

- The ability to self-serve in analytics and experimentation results - you don't wait on an analyst to know how your programs are performing.

- A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI

- A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.

- Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

- Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

- Genuine familiarity with hunting culture, or a personal passion for hunting and the outdoors - you understand the seasons, the preparation, and why an offline map matters at 6 a.m. in a dead zone.

- Experience with Liquid templating (or similar) for dynamic personalization in Braze.

- Experience partnering with data science teams to deploy propensity or churn models in production campaigns.

- Experience optimizing trial-based subscription funnels and paywalls.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Dakota, West Virginia, or Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $115,000 and $145,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com  or directly via our LinkedIn page.

onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. For more information, see our Privacy Policy .

As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt-out if preferred.
